title: Netflix Releases Trailer for 'On Behalf of My Son,' Featuring a Moving Performance by Rejane Faria
summary: On Wednesday, October 7, Netflix released the official trailer for On Behalf of My Son, Gabriel Martins’ new film, starring Rejane Faria.
body_markdown:
São Paulo, October 7, 2026 —


On Wednesday, October 7, Netflix released the official trailer for


On Behalf of My Son


, Gabriel Martins’ new film, starring Rejane Faria. The trailer introduces Vicentina, a 75-year-old retired teacher who, after losing her son in a tragic bus accident, decides to seek out the victims’ families to apologize on his behalf. In the trailer, Rejane is Vicentina, a grieving woman on a search for answers. After the accident that claimed the life of her son Wesley, who was driving the bus, makes headlines and raises questions about his responsibility in the tragedy, she decides to seek out the victims’ families to apologize on his behalf. Through these encounters, Vicentina is confronted with diverging accounts of what happened and with the lasting impact of the tragedy. Through encounters and silences, she attempts to piece together her son’s final moments and to find a way to cope with her own grief and move forward. The film, a collaboration between production company Filmes de Plástico and Netflix, features Rejane Faria, Flávio Bauraqui, Giovanna Heliodoro, Giovanni Venturini, Grace Passô, Karine Teles, Maíra Azevedo, Renato Novaes and Thalma de Freitas in the main cast. Following its international premiere at the 51st Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) and its selection for the official competition at the San Sebastián International Film Festival,


On Behalf of My Son


now arrives in Brazil to compete in the 28th edition of the Rio Film Festival. The feature was also selected by the Brazilian Film Academy to represent Brazil in the race for the 2027 Goya Awards.


On Behalf of My Son


premieres at the Rio Film Festival this Friday (October 9), opens in select theaters on November 5, and premieres on Netflix on November 20.


About


On Behalf of My Son


Synopsis:


A packed bus is heading towards downtown Belo Horizonte on a sunny morning. As it crosses the viaduct, the vehicle suddenly swerves, veers off the road and plunges into the avenue below. One passenger is seriously injured, while everyone else — including Wesley, the driver — is killed. The tragedy dominates television news and newspaper headlines across the country. Security cameras on the bus and on the road capture the moment of the accident, and after the footage is analyzed, speculation begins to spread that the driver may have acted deliberately. Vicentina, a 75-year-old retired teacher and Wesley’s mother, is devastated by the tragedy and unable to see a way forward. She decides to seek out the victims’ families and apologize. The road ahead proves difficult, and the answers Vicentina is so desperately seeking are not always the ones she finds.

About Netflix


Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.


About Filmes de Plástico


Founded in 2009 by André Novais Oliveira, Gabriel Martins, Maurilio Martins and Thiago Macêdo Correia, FILMES DE PLÁSTICO is one of Brazil's leading film production companies, recognized for films that portray Black and working-class communities with honesty and dignity. Its productions have been screened and received awards at major international festivals such as Cannes, Berlin, Sundance, Locarno and Rotterdam and, in 2023, the company's film


Mars One


represented Brazil as the official submission for the 95th Academy Awards®. In addition to developing its own projects locally, the production company also trains and fosters emerging talent within its community.
